title: Invertibility of the evaluation comparison
statement: For l, E, L, ι, X, tensor presentations a and b, and complete ambient inputs K and M with hK and hM, the evaluation comparison v l E L ι X a b K M hK hM is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the finite-free evaluation-transpose theorem homMap_isIso. Unfold v and compose this middle isomorphism with the inverse completion comparison on the internal-Hom source and the target internal-Hom functor applied to the completion isomorphisms of K and M; the latter map is an isomorphism by functoriality.
